description: Literature-derived benchmark dataset of 32 published genome editing cases with measured editing outcomes. Each case is from a peer-reviewed publication where the editing strategy was ACTUALLY USED and efficiency was MEASURED. Cases span base editing (ABE/CBE), prime editing (PE), and HDR strategies. Category D cases tested multiple strategies at the same locus.
curation_notes: All PMIDs verified via PubMed. Efficiency values extracted from published figures/text. Values marked 'verify_from_paper' require confirmation from the original manuscript supplementary data.

cases.strategy_detail: Convert SCD allele (HBB-S) to Makassar beta-globin (HBB-G) via A-to-G edit
cases.efficiency_metric: HBB-S to HBB-G conversion in patient HSPCs ex vivo
cases.additional_outcomes: 68% HBB-G frequency 16 weeks post-transplant in mice; 5-fold reduction in sickling
cases.notes: Same locus also corrected by HDR (Dever 2016, Lattanzi 2021) and prime editing (Everette 2023)

cases.cell_type: Patient fibroblasts (in vitro); mouse model (in vivo)
cases.strategy_detail: Correct C>T to restore normal splicing, preventing progerin production
cases.efficiency_metric: 87-91% correction of pathogenic allele in patient fibroblasts (lentiviral); 20-60% in vivo across organs at 6 months
cases.additional_outcomes: Median lifespan extended from 215 to 510 days in mice; single AAV9 injection
cases.notes: Landmark in vivo base editing study. In vitro efficiency 87-91%; in vivo 20-60% depending on organ.

cases.variant_hgvs: Splice site disruption (not correcting existing variant; creating loss-of-function)
cases.strategy_detail: Disrupt PCSK9 splice site in liver via LNP-delivered ABE mRNA
cases.efficiency_metric: ~67% editing in mouse liver; near-complete PCSK9 knockdown in primates
cases.additional_outcomes: 90% reduction in blood PCSK9; ~60% reduction in LDL cholesterol; stable for 8+ months
cases.notes: First in vivo base editing in non-human primates. Mouse efficiency ~67%; primate editing also high with durable effects.

cases.strategy_detail: LNP-delivered ABE mRNA targeting PCSK9 splice site
cases.efficiency_metric: Up to 34% (average 26%) in macaque liver; up to 67% (average 61%) in mouse liver
cases.additional_outcomes: 32% reduction in plasma PCSK9; 14% reduction in LDL in macaques
cases.notes: Independent replication of PCSK9 base editing in primates. Lower efficiency than Musunuru study but confirmed therapeutic effect.

cases.strategy_detail: Correct nonsense mutation C>T (on coding strand) back to wild-type
cases.efficiency_metric: 94.6% correction of pathogenic allele in patient fibroblasts
cases.additional_outcomes: Restored COL7A1 mRNA and C7 protein expression; no detectable off-target effects
cases.notes: Exceptionally high efficiency for single-gene correction in patient-derived cells.

cases.variant_hgvs: Pahenu2 mouse model (homologous to human PAH point mutation)
cases.strategy_detail: In vivo AAV-delivered split-intein ABE correcting Pah point mutation in liver
cases.efficiency_metric: Up to 63% mRNA correction rate in liver
cases.additional_outcomes: Restored PAH enzyme activity; normalized blood phenylalanine below 120 umol/L; reverted light fur phenotype
cases.notes: First in vivo base editing for metabolic liver disease. Phenotypic rescue demonstrated.

cases.strategy_detail: BE3-mediated correction of FBN1 T7498C mutation
cases.efficiency_metric: ~89% perfect correction in human embryos
cases.additional_outcomes: No off-target effects or indels detected by deep sequencing + WGS
cases.notes: Proof-of-principle for genetic correction of Marfan syndrome in human embryos.

cases.variant_hgvs: BCL11A erythroid enhancer +58 (therapeutic disruption, not correcting existing variant)
cases.strategy_detail: Disrupt BCL11A erythroid enhancer to reactivate fetal hemoglobin (HbF)
cases.efficiency_metric: 93.3% and 90.6% editing in CD34+ HSPCs from two beta-thalassemia patients
cases.additional_outcomes: Prevented sickling in SCD erythroid progeny; ameliorated globin chain imbalance in beta-thal
cases.notes: CBE-based therapeutic approach targeting regulatory element rather than coding mutation.

cases.variant_hgvs: Fah c.706G>A (splice-site mutation in Fahenu2 mouse)
cases.strategy_detail: Hydrodynamic injection of ABE plasmid to correct Fah splice-site mutation
cases.efficiency_metric: <10% initial editing, but corrected hepatocytes expand due to selective advantage
cases.additional_outcomes: Generated FAH+ hepatocytes in liver; rescued weight loss; mice survived off NTBC
cases.notes: Low initial editing but therapeutic rescue due to selective expansion of corrected hepatocytes.

cases.strategy_detail: PE3 correction of E6V mutation back to wild-type HBB
cases.efficiency_metric: 26-52% correction across 14 pegRNAs; up to 58% with PAM-modifying silent mutation
cases.additional_outcomes: Average indels 2.8% +/- 0.70%; high editing:indel ratio
cases.notes: Original prime editing paper. Demonstrated correction of SCD mutation with multiple pegRNA designs.

cases.strategy_detail: PE3b correction of 4-bp insertion causing Tay-Sachs
cases.efficiency_metric: 33% with PE3b; 0.32% indels
cases.additional_outcomes: PE3 achieved >20% editing; PE3b improved product purity
cases.notes: 4-bp deletion correction not achievable by base editors, demonstrating PE's unique capability.

cases.strategy_detail: Install protective G127V variant in PRNP using PE3
cases.efficiency_metric: 270-fold higher editing:indel ratio for PE3 vs Cas9-initiated HDR
cases.additional_outcomes: Demonstrated dramatically improved precision of PE over HDR at this locus
cases.notes: Direct comparison of PE3 vs Cas9-HDR showing 270x better editing:indel ratio.

cases.strategy_detail: Ex vivo prime editing of SCD HSPCs; correct E6V to wild-type
cases.efficiency_metric: 15-41% correction in patient HSPCs across 4 donors
cases.additional_outcomes: 42% HBBA in erythroblasts/reticulocytes 17 weeks post-transplant; exceeds therapeutic threshold
cases.notes: First ex vivo prime editing for SCD in patient HSPCs with engraftment data. Same locus as Newby ABE (80%) and Dever HDR (29%).

cases.strategy_detail: Correct 1-bp duplication causing frameshift in ATP7B in liver organoids
cases.efficiency_metric: 30-50% efficiency in organoid cells; 21% correct edit in unselected cells
cases.additional_outcomes: Functional recovery validated by copper stress survival assay; 1-4% indels
cases.notes: First PE in patient-derived organoids. Also tested PE for DGAT1 deficiency in intestinal organoids. Compared PE vs HDR.

cases.strategy_detail: Correct DGAT1 mutation in intestinal stem cells grown as organoids
cases.efficiency_metric: 21% correct edit in unselected cells; 8% indels; 71% unedited
cases.additional_outcomes: Functional validation of lipid metabolism restoration in corrected organoids
cases.notes: Same study as LIT_PE_005. Demonstrates PE works efficiently in primary 3D organoid cultures.

cases.cell_type: Immortalized bronchial epithelial cells (16HBE) and patient airway epithelial cells
cases.strategy_detail: Systematic optimization of PE for F508del correction: epegRNAs, PEmax, MLH1dn, PE6, dead sgRNAs
cases.efficiency_metric: 58% in immortalized bronchial epithelial cells; 25% in patient airway epithelial cells
cases.additional_outcomes: Restored >50% of wild-type CFTR function; comparable to current CF drug treatments
cases.notes: Highest PE efficiency for F508del. Combined 6 optimization strategies to increase from <0.5% to 58%.

cases.strategy_detail: Dual AAV delivery of split-intein prime editor to correct PiZ mutation in mouse liver
cases.efficiency_metric: Demonstrated correction in mouse liver; later optimized to 72% in humanized mice (Prime Medicine 2025)
cases.additional_outcomes: Restored AAT protein expression; improved liver histology
cases.notes: First dual-AAV prime editing in vivo. Also modeled cancer (Ctnnb1 S45F) by somatic PE. Exact PiZ correction efficiency: verify from paper.

cases.cell_type: Patient-derived rectal organoids and nasal epithelial cells
cases.strategy_detail: Correct F508del and other CFTR mutations (L227R, N1303K) in patient organoids
cases.efficiency_metric: Functional rescue of CFTR protein glycosylation, localization, and ion channel function
cases.additional_outcomes: Complex glycosylation and membrane localization of CFTR restored; validated in organoid swelling assays
cases.notes: Tested multiple CFTR mutations. Functional validation in patient organoids.

cases.strategy_detail: CRISPR/Cas9 RNP + rAAV6 homologous donor for HBB gene correction at E6V
cases.efficiency_metric: Average 29% targeted integration in HSPCs; >90% in enriched population
cases.additional_outcomes: Corrected HSPCs express adult HbA mRNA; intact transcriptional regulation confirmed
cases.notes: Landmark HDR study in HSCs. Same locus later addressed by ABE (Newby 2021, 80%) and PE (Everette 2023, 15-41%).

cases.strategy_detail: Clinical-grade HiFi Cas9 + chemically modified sgRNA + rAAV6 HBB donor at clinical scale
cases.efficiency_metric: Up to 60% HBB allelic correction at clinical scale; 20% gene correction after transplantation
cases.additional_outcomes: No genotoxicity or tumorigenicity detected; durable correction in immunodeficient mice
cases.notes: Clinical-scale HDR manufacturing. IND-enabling study for SCD gene correction therapy.

cases.strategy_detail: CRISPR/Cas9 HDR-mediated correction of CFTR in intestinal organoids from CF patients
cases.efficiency_metric: Clonal selection; corrected organoids showed forskolin-induced swelling comparable to wild-type (177-187% surface area increase)
cases.additional_outcomes: Functional CFTR protein expression restored; first demonstration of CRISPR correction in patient organoids
cases.notes: Pioneering study: first CRISPR HDR correction in patient-derived organoids. Efficiency based on clonal selection.

cases.strategy_detail: CRISPR-Cas9 RNP + AAV6 donor template for ELANE L172P correction in patient HSPCs
cases.efficiency_metric: Up to 40% (sgELANE-ex4) and 56% (sgELANE-L172P) HDR in patient HSPCs
cases.additional_outcomes: Restored neutrophilic maturation; corrected cells showed normal differentiation
cases.notes: HDR correction in primary HSPCs for severe congenital neutropenia.

cases.strategy_detail: Cas9-AAV6 gene correction of beta-globin in autologous HSCs
cases.efficiency_metric: Stable HgbA production demonstrated in SCD mice transplanted with E6V-corrected HSPCs
cases.additional_outcomes: Improved erythropoiesis in transplanted mice; durable correction
cases.notes: Autologous HSC correction with in vivo validation. Same locus extensively studied by all three strategies.

cases.strategy_detail: CRISPR/Cas9 correction of homozygous L444P GBA mutation in patient iPSCs
cases.efficiency_metric: Generated corrected GBA+/- and GBA+/+ isogenic lines from patient iPSCs
cases.additional_outcomes: Restored GCase activity, motility, and phagocytosis in iPSC-derived macrophages
cases.notes: Functional rescue confirmed in iPSC-derived macrophages. Exact efficiency values need verification from paper.

cases.variant_hgvs: NM_000518.5:c.20A>T (p.Glu7Val, E6V) and prothrombin F2 c.*97G>A
cases.strategy_detail: HDRobust: combined transient inhibition of NHEJ and MMEJ to maximize HDR point mutation efficiency
cases.efficiency_metric: Up to 93% (median 60%) HDR across 58 target sites; 17-72% at 5 specific pathogenic loci
cases.additional_outcomes: Outcome purity 67-90%; validated for anemia, SCD, and thrombophilia correction
cases.notes: Systematic HDR optimization. 58 target sites tested. Dramatically improved HDR purity over standard protocols.

cases.strategy_detail: Double-nicking CRISPR/Cas9-HDR with ssODN template to correct G2019S in patient iPSCs
cases.efficiency_metric: Clonal selection from ~50 colonies; isogenic lines generated and validated
cases.additional_outcomes: Rescued parkinsonism phenotypes in iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons; novel pathway candidates identified
cases.notes: Also compared to ABE correction method for same mutation. Clonal approach typical for iPSC HDR.

cases.variant_hgvs: Multiple endogenous loci in HEK293T and K562
cases.strategy_detail: cssDNA donors produced via ssDNA phage for efficient and robust HDR-mediated insertion
cases.efficiency_metric: cssDNA integration frequencies superior to linear ssDNA; high biallelic integration rates
cases.additional_outcomes: Efficient fluorescent tag knockins at endogenous sites; reduced cytotoxicity in iPSCs
cases.notes: Key reference for cssDNA donor technology. Demonstrates superior performance over linear ssDNA donors.

cases.strategy: Multi-strategy comparison (ABE vs PE vs HDR)
cases.strategy_detail: Three independent studies at HBB E6V locus enabling cross-strategy comparison
cases.efficiency_metric: ABE: 80% (Newby 2021) | PE: 15-41% (Everette 2023) | HDR-AAV6: 29% (Dever 2016), 60% (Lattanzi 2021)
cases.additional_outcomes: ABE achieves highest raw efficiency but produces Makassar variant (not WT). PE achieves exact correction with lowest indels. HDR achieves intermediate efficiency but with highest indels.
cases.journal: Nature / Nat Biomed Eng / Sci Transl Med
cases.notes: MOST VALUABLE BENCHMARK CASE. HBB E6V is the most comprehensively studied locus with all three strategies tested in clinically relevant HSPCs.

cases.strategy_detail: ABE to skip exon 51 by disrupting splice donor; PE to reframe by inserting 2nt into exon 52
cases.efficiency_metric: ABE: efficient splice site disruption in iPSC-cardiomyocytes. PE: restored dystrophin 24.8-39.7% of normal levels.

base_editing.strategy: Splice donor disruption for exon 51 skipping

prime_editing.strategy: 2-nt insertion in exon 52 to restore reading frame

cases.additional_outcomes: Both strategies restored dystrophin ORF and protein expression. ABE also validated in vivo via AAV9 intramuscular injection in deltaEx51 mice.
cases.notes: Same paper compares ABE and PE for DMD correction. ABE via splice site disruption; PE via reading frame restoration.

cases.strategy_detail: PE3 vs Cas9-HDR for correcting 1-bp duplication in liver organoids
cases.efficiency_metric: PE: 30-50% correct editing with 1-4% indels. HDR: compared but PE offered greater precision.
cases.additional_outcomes: PE as efficient in 3D organoids as in 2D cell lines. PE offered greater precision than HDR.
cases.notes: Direct PE vs HDR comparison in same paper. PE showed better precision in organoids.

cases.nuclease: SpCas9 (DSB for HDR; nicking for PE)
cases.strategy_detail: Direct comparison of PE3 vs Cas9-initiated HDR with ssODN at PRNP locus
cases.efficiency_metric: PE3 editing:indel ratio was 270-fold higher than Cas9-HDR at this locus
cases.additional_outcomes: Dramatic difference in editing purity favoring PE over HDR
cases.notes: Original PE paper. 270x better edit:indel ratio is one of the strongest demonstrations of PE's precision advantage.

cases.nuclease: SpCas9 (nicking for both BE and PE)
cases.strategy_detail: CBE to install A673T + bystander E674K; PE to install A673T only without bystanders
cases.efficiency_metric: CBE: 53% editing but with bystander E674K mutation. PE: up to 64% with repeated treatment, A673T only.
cases.additional_outcomes: Both reduced BACE1 cleavage. PE achieved cleaner edit without bystander mutations.
cases.journal: Molecular Therapy Nucleic Acids (CBE) / CRISPR Journal (PE)
cases.notes: Illustrates bystander editing problem with CBE that PE avoids. Relevant for strategy selection algorithms.

cases.variant_hgvs: DMD exon 52 deletion and exon 45-52 deletion
cases.strategy_detail: Three PE strategies: (1) splice donor substitution of exon 53 (32% HEK293T, 28% myoblasts), (2) G deletion at splice site (44% HEK293T, 29% myoblasts), (3) GGG insertion at exon 51 splice site (17% HEK293T, 5.5% myoblasts)
cases.efficiency_metric: Best strategy: 44% in HEK293T, 29% in patient myoblasts (G deletion approach)
cases.additional_outcomes: Multiple PE strategies compared within same study for DMD exon skipping
cases.notes: Compares three different PE strategies for the same disease. Useful for understanding optimal PE design.

hbb_e6v_comparison.description: HBB E6V (sickle cell) is the most comprehensively benchmarked locus with data from all three strategies
